name: event-between-runs-fatal
description: an ordinary event between two runs belongs to neither and is fatal: after RUN_FINISHED only RUN_STARTED and RUN_ERROR may arrive, and that a run follows on the same stream does not change it. What the closed run delivered stays, and the run after the event is not read. Local to this repository: the upstream event-after-run-finished-fatal ends at the offending event
kill: treat a closed run as open again for whatever arrives before the next RUN_STARTED, so the state snapshot between the two runs is applied

expect.errorContains: The run has already finished with 'RUN_FINISHED'
